blocks.html:
This method manages the sales channels of a stock location by adding or removing them. It sends a request to the
[Manage Stock Location Sales Channels](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/admin#stock-locations\_poststocklocationsidsaleschannels)
API route.

types.name: id
types.description: The ID of the stock location to update the sales channels for.

types.name: body
types.description: The details of the sales channels to update.

children.name: add
children.description: The IDs of the sales channels to add to the stock location.

children.name: remove
children.description: The IDs of the sales channels to remove from the stock location.

types.name: headers
types.description: Headers to pass in the request.
